name: Amarnath
reason: Common name; meaning and scripts correct.

name: Avadhesh
reason: Common name for Rama; avadha + īśa sandhi correct.

name: Avighna
reason: Used as a modern name; Ganesha association, meaning correct.

name: Bajrang
reason: Devanagari/IAST gave the Sanskrit source vajrāṅga, not the name Bajrang; corrected to the Hindi form.

fix.name: Bajrang
fix.meaning_en: Body as strong as a thunderbolt (from Sanskrit vajrāṅga); Hanuman.

name: Ganapati
reason: Used as a given name; correct.

name: Hara
reason: Name of Shiva also used as a given name; meaning acceptable.

name: Kanha
reason: IAST omitted the final long vowel of कान्हा.

fix.name: Kanha
fix.meaning_en: A loving Hindi name for the child Krishna.

name: Kesarinandan
reason: Used as a name for Hanuman; scripts correct.

name: Narahari
reason: Established name; hari = lion here, meaning correct.

name: Rajaram
reason: Common name in the राजाराम form; correct.

name: Saravanan
reason: IAST used Tamil ISO 'caravaṇaṉ', inconsistent with the Sanskrit-based Devanagari.

fix.name: Saravanan
fix.meaning_en: Born in the Saravana reed lake; Murugan.

name: Senthil
reason: Devanagari सेन्दिल् misspells the name; IAST used Tamil ISO; meaning tightened.

fix.name: Senthil
fix.meaning_en: Murugan, named after Senthil (Tiruchendur), his shore shrine.

name: Shanmugam
reason: IAST ṣaṇmukam did not match the Devanagari षण्मुगम्.

name: Vaikunth
reason: Used as a given name; correct.

name: Vanamali
reason: Script gave the stem vanamālin; the name is the nominative vanamālī.

fix.name: Vanamali
fix.meaning_en: Wearing a garland of forest flowers; Krishna.

name: Velan
reason: IAST used Tamil ISO 'vēlaṉ'; aligned with the Devanagari.
